title: The Morning Digest: November 3, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $104.77 on Monday, down $8.66 or 7.63 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled at $96.46, down $7.66 or 7.36 percent (Reuters), the biggest one-day percentage decline since July, after Iran's president said the Supreme Leader had granted the government authority to pursue peace talks and the US president cast doubt on resuming strikes. Overnight Brent was up 48 cents to $105.25 at 0104 GMT on a reported US strike on Qeshm Island and was flat by 0355 GMT. No agreement exists and no flow print has moved, with loadings west of Hormuz at about 11 million barrels a day on the last gauge. December WCS is -$30.69 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 2) on 475 lots, November Mainline apportionment of Light 19 percent and Heavy 7 percent at Kerrobert is in effect, and the validated diesel crack is $93.10.
